b:
O breath of my life,
O breath of my life,
you are leaving me

Forgetting your little smile,
feeling some lack,
where are you going?

If you go far away
I will follow you like a shadow,
I will live frozen in your memories;
you will lose, my girl

I will bloom in your dreams,
I will be soaked in your poems,
as the life of every scene
you will see me.
A bee that has drunk honey
leans,
looking for a lap,
at the corner of your lips

A love
born of fate
settles
in the corner of the heart!

Are you standing unmoved?
You look as if to rule me.
One word from you is enough,
and life will be complete,
as you and me
